text:
Maya (Sales): Hey team — Orchid Health POC moving fast. Procurement asked for signed MSA+DPA before we kick infra. Questions: they want a KMS/HSM clause, SLA bumped to 99.9 for Dedicated, and PO net45. Can legal/finance ack any hard blockers?

Jin (SE): For the POC we only need the hosted offer for first 30 days. We can defer Dedicated SLA until post-PO, but Orchid said infra gating blocks configs. timeline: need signed docs + PO by end of next week to hit their test window.

Priya (Procurement): Net45 is ok but need vendor portal info and a W-9 for payments. Also they want invoices split: 70% on start, 30% on go-live. Please confirm.

Omar (Legal): KMS language: we can add a limited clause referencing customer-managed keys in the Private deployment addendum. DPA: remove absolute deletion guarantee, replace with "reasonable efforts" + audit trail. SLA 99.9 is higher than standard for Dedicated; we can offer it only on a committed Dedicated contract. Suggest we propose a pilot addendum that limits SLA to "best effort" for the POC.

Carlos (Finance): Splitting invoices is doable but needs to be on the order form. We'll accept Net45 for the POC if billing contact is provided. Also need PO number before provisioning.

Maya (Sales): Action items then: (1) Omar to provide redline suggestions for MSA+DPA KMS clause, (2) Priya to confirm vendor onboarding checklist and if Orchid can provide W-9, (3) Carlos to provision payment terms in order form template.

Omar (Legal): Uploaded a redline link: https://redwood.internal/sigs/orchid-msadpa-redline-v1 (see comments around §7 KMS and §12 SLA). Main ask: keep SLA conditional on Dedicated commit, add service credits formula.

Priya (Procurement): Orchid rep (Sara) said they can provide W-9 and PO early next week. @Maya can you share the billing email? Also, do we need SOC2 attestation attached? They requested SOC2 Type II.

Maya (Sales): Billing contact is billing@redwood-internal.example (use for PO). Yes they asked for SOC2 — we can share our attestation PDF from the portal. Jin please attach the SOC2 link in the order form.

Jin (SE): SOC2 link: https://docs.redwood.com/compliance/soc2-2025.pdf. Order form snippet for split billing: ```
  Charges: 70% due within 30 days of signature, remainder due within 30 days of go-live.
  Net Terms: Net45
  PO: Required prior to provisioning
```

Carlos (Finance): I'll add the split billing lines to the order form template and draft invoice schedule. Will confirm when done — target EOD tomorrow.

DeployBot: DocuSign envelope created for Orchid MSA (envelope id: env_0a9c). Waiting for signatures.

Maya (Sales): Can legal confirm if the KMS redline is acceptable to escalate to customer? Omar?

Omar (Legal): Quick read: KMS clause looks fine but replace "HSM" with "customer-managed key material" and add audit log requirement. I'll prepare a clean mark for customer review.

Priya (Procurement): Once Omar posts the clean mark, I'll start vendor onboarding and share the portal invite to Sara. Please cc billing.

Maya (Sales): Great — I'll update Orchid and push for PO + W-9 next week. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Carlos (Finance): Noted. Will ping if PO needs special routing.

Jin (SE): We'll hold infra until PO and signed MSA arrive. Ready to jump once docs are in.

Maya (Sales): Closing loop — timeline looks like: redlines today, clean mark + order form tomorrow, PO early next week, provisioning after that. I'll keep the channel updated.

Omar (Legal): 👍

Priya (Procurement): 👍

Carlos (Finance): 👍
